column1: # p4browser — single-core P4-only layout (no C6 co-processor in v1).
# CRITICAL FIX: the previous layout (copied from the Guition C6 device) put the
# primary app partition "ota_0" at 0x90000 and a C6 slot "c6_bl" at 0x10000.
# We flashed our app to 0x10000 (per flash_args)
# it — it always booted the stale factory JD9365 "p4smoke" test sitting at
# 0x90000. Every "no video" result was that old firmware
# Now the app lives in the primary ota_0 slot at 0x10000 (bootloader default)
# so the P4 actually runs our build.
